Suited to people who are willing to work hands-on on walls, equipment, or other structural surfaces and can follow work orders, coating instructions, and quality standards.

risks.mitigation: Do not go up when conditions are unverified; hand equipment and protection to the project safety lead for confirmation.
risks.scenario: Going up when ladder or scaffold conditions are unverified.
risks.title: Falls from height.

risks.mitigation: For unknown composition, stop disturbing it and report, and verify the applicable investigation and handling requirements.
risks.scenario: Old coatings of unknown composition being scraped and sanded directly.
risks.title: Old-paint dust.

risks.mitigation: Operated by trained personnel per the SDS, ventilation, and respiratory protection procedures.
risks.scenario: Spraying without verifying the materials and the ventilation protection.
risks.title: Spray exposure.

risks.consequence: Fire may occur and affect people.
risks.mitigation: Control ignition sources and storage per the material instructions and the project's flammable-materials procedures.
risks.scenario: Ignition-source control not verified when storing and mixing solvent-based coatings.
risks.title: Flammable solvents.

risks.consequence: May cause skin or eye irritation injuries.
risks.mitigation: Verify contact protection per the SDS, and handle anomalies by stopping work per procedures.
risks.scenario: Inadequate contact protection for cleaning fluids or coatings.
risks.title: Skin and eye irritation.

risks.consequence: May cause poor adhesion, blistering, or rework.
risks.mitigation: Verify the technical data, site conditions, and sample, and do not self-accept unresolved items.
risks.scenario: Topcoating when the substrate is damp or uncleaned or the interval does not match.
risks.title: Coating failure.
